ModMetaData.name: Aspiration Control
ModMetaData.author: Faeris
ModMetaData.description:
Reworks the fulfillment need row from Vanilla Aspirations Expanded and lets you choose a pawn's aspirations.
The aspiration icons used to be drawn below the need row with a fixed size, so they spilled over the next need and over the bars around them. They are now laid out inside the row they belong to: the icon strip is sized from the width, height and aspiration count of whatever rect the need is drawn in, and the bar above it shrinks to make room. It fits the vanilla needs tab, the character editor needs page and any other window that draws the need.
Click an aspiration icon to pick a different aspiration for that slot, or to clear it. A pawn with fewer than five aspirations gets an empty slot at the end for adding one. Aspirations that do not suit the pawn are listed too, marked as unsuited. Changing a slot resets its progress and rechecks the new aspiration straight away, so one the pawn already satisfies completes at once.
With Character Editor installed, a pawn's aspirations and their completion are stored in the character preset, so saving and reloading a character brings back exactly the same aspirations. Presets saved before this mod still load.
Requires Vanilla Aspirations Expanded and Harmony.
